parameters.query:
=INSERT INTO candidates (
  name, email, phone, linkedin_url, educational_background, professional_background, experiences, skills, match_status
) VALUES (
  '{{ $json.data.name.replace(/'/g, "\\'") }}',
  '{{ $json.data.email }}',
  '{{ $json.data.phone }}',
  '{{ $json.data.linkedin_url }}',
  '{{ ($json.data.educational_background || '').replace(/'/g, "\\'") }}',
  '{{ ($json.data.professional_background || '').replace(/'/g, "\\'") }}',
  '{{ ($json.data.experiences || '').replace(/'/g, "\\'") }}',
  '{{ ($json.data.skills || '').replace(/'/g, "\\'") }}',
  'Pending'
);

=UPDATE candidates 
SET match_status = '{{ $json.match_status }}',
    match_score = {{ $json.match_score }},
    match_reason = '{{ $json.match_reason.replace(/'/g, "\\'") }}'
WHERE id = {{ $json.candidate_id }};

parameters.responseBody:
={
  "success": true,
  "candidate_id": {{ $('Cross Check CV vs LinkedIn').item.json.candidate_id }},
  "match_status": "{{ $('Cross Check CV vs LinkedIn').item.json.match_status }}",
  "match_score": {{ $('Cross Check CV vs LinkedIn').item.json.match_score }},
  "match_reason": "{{ $('Cross Check CV vs LinkedIn').item.json.match_reason }}",
  "candidate": $('Cross Check CV vs LinkedIn').item.json.cv_data,
  "linkedin_profile": $('Cross Check CV vs LinkedIn').item.json.linkedin_data
}
